column4: a warrior raises a long staff high above his head with both hands, then brings it smashing straight down in front of him, and recovers to a ready stance
a warrior holding a long staff in both hands at his waist steps forward and thrusts it straight ahead hard, then pulls it back to guard
a warrior twirls a long staff in a fast circle beside his body with one hand, then plants it and strikes a proud pose
a person runs two steps, leaps high into the air in a forward flip over an obstacle, and lands on both feet on the other side
a person crouches down low, then springs straight up high into the air with both arms swinging up
a person jumps up and, at the top of the jump, swings a staff down hard with both hands, then lands bent-kneed
a person drops from a height and lands hard in a low crouch with one hand touching the ground, then rises to a ready stance
a big strong man lowers his head and charges forward like a bull, running hard with his head down and shoulders hunched
a big man lunges forward and rams his head forward hard in a headbutt, then pulls back
a person is struck hard in the face, his head snaps back and he staggers backwards two steps, then recovers his balance
a person is struck hard and knocked off his feet, falling backwards and landing flat on his back on the ground
a person falls backwards through the air, arms and legs flailing, out of control
a person lying flat on his back on the ground rolls to one side, pushes up to his knees and stands up, shaking his head
a person stands dazed and dizzy, wobbling, swaying in small circles and stumbling, about to fall over
a fighter stands tall and beckons the enemy forward, curling the fingers of one raised hand toward himself, come on
a warrior stands in a low wide ready stance holding a staff across his body with both hands, shifting his weight, watching his enemy
a big strong man stands in a wide low wrestler's stance with fists raised, swaying and stamping, ready to fight
a big angry man stomps his right foot hard on the ground twice, snorting, ready to charge
a person stands up straight, lowers his arms and bows his head in defeat
a person raises one fist high in triumph and cheers
a person with his back against a wall slides down it and slumps into a sitting position on the ground, dazed
a person bends the knees deeply into a low squat, then jumps straight up as high as possible, and lands
a dizzy person staggers in a small circle, swaying the upper body around and around, arms loose, nearly falling
a person lying on his back on the ground sits up, gets onto one knee, and stands up straight
a defeated fighter lowers his head and bows deeply forward from the waist, arms hanging, then stays bowed
a person lifts the right knee high and stamps the foot down hard on the ground, then does it again
a big man runs forward fast, bent forward at the waist with his head lowered like a charging bull
a man bends forward at the waist and drives the top of his head forward hard like a ram butting, then straightens up
a strong man lowers his head and lunges forward, ramming with his forehead, arms back, then steps back
